reason: A permission-rule utility for DeepSeek Harness that controls tool execution with scoped matching rules and provides a persistent visual editor for managing them.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于规则的工具权限拦截、持久化配置和可视化编辑功能。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness utility that applies scoped permission rules to tool calls and provides persistent visual configuration.

capabilities: Intercepts tool pre-execution calls and applies permission rules
Allows, prompts for, denies, or hard-denies matching tool calls
Provides a visual settings editor and custom rules API endpoints
Injects active permission rules into the system prompt
